title: manifest.jsonl — ministry Detailed Demands for Grants (DDG)
description: One ministry-hosted 'Detailed Demands for Grants' acquisition record. text_layer: false marks flattened-scan editions that need OCR before object-head parsing. The wayback_* fields are present only when acquisition was run with Wayback provenance enabled: wayback_url is the citable capture of the source URL as acquired, and wayback_digest is the CDX content digest, which lets a later re-check detect that the source changed without downloading either version. wayback_status distinguishes a new capture this run's save produced (captured) from a save that was accepted while the newest indexed capture is still the pre-existing one (save-pending) from one that already existed with no save requested (existing) from no capture at all (unarchived) from the Internet Archive being unreachable (unavailable) — the last two are different facts and must not be collapsed.

text_layer.description: Whether the PDF reads back as text. Null means extraction was not attempted, or the toolchain could not run — never assume false: a file that cannot be read is still acquired.
